name: wechat-local-export
description: Orchestrate authorized, local-only Mac WeChat 4.x exports through a fail-closed helper with dry-scan confirmation.

interface.shortDescription: Safely scan and export local Mac WeChat records
interface.longDescription: Use natural-language chat and time descriptions to create a read-only dry scan, require an exact confirmation, and then invoke a local helper. This development package ships no signed companion and does not upload chat data.
defaultPrompt: Export the messages from a Mac WeChat group for a specific time range.
Dry-scan the voice messages in a WeChat chat, then wait for my confirmation.
